method: Uniform scale onto the hip section; belt inner face drawn onto skin and panties, fur pushed out only and otherwise hung from the belt through ARAP; medallion, rings and loops ride the belt rigidly; the braid is laid onto the front panel slice by slice.

weights.method: Inverse-distance transfer from skin; panel leg influence capped by height below the belt with the rest on Hips; the belt keeps skin weights; medallion, rings and loops rigid on the bone that dominates the belt around them; smoothed across the welded surface; braid copies the panel under it.

rigging.method: Inverse-distance transfer from skin; panel leg influence capped by height below the belt with the rest on Hips; the belt keeps skin weights; medallion, rings and loops rigid on the bone that dominates the belt around them; smoothed across the welded surface; braid copies the panel under it.
